text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
When I noticed your light on, I didn't
want to
believe you'd still be awake, yet
here we are.

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
You're looking awfully pale. Have you
been
getting enough rest?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Riko Kashimoto—an executive member of the
URA currently employed by
Tracen Academy—is
suddenly standing
beside me.

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
What would the students think if you, a
trainer, were to collapse from
exhaustion? You should be
more mindful
of your position.
choice_data_list: I've been a little busy lately...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Her warning is harsh, but I can't help
noticing she
must have also just finished
a rough day of work.

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
Well... I suppose I'm in no position to
scold others
for working late today.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
We head out of the office while sharing
some
notes and information with each
other.
